1) 从告警标签取 agent_host 与 agent_type，执行 ope: 1) Take agent_host and agent_type from the alert labels and confirm the state with openstack network agent list; 2) Log in to that node and run systemctl status neutron-openvswitch-agent (or the matching agent) to check the process and logs; 3) If the process is alive but the heartbeat has timed out, check connectivity from that node to the message queue (RabbitMQ); agent heartbeats travel over RPC, so an unreachable MQ is the most common cause; 4) After recovery run openstack network agent list to confirm alive is True and spot-check networking on one VM on that node.
1) 从告警标签取 host_machine 与 name，执行 opensta: 1) Take host_machine and name from the alert labels and confirm the state with openstack compute service list; 2) Check the change record to determine whether this is planned maintenance; 3) If unplanned, log in to the compute node and check the nova-compute process and connectivity to the MQ and database; 4) Once the node is confirmed healthy, clear the flag with nova service-force-down <host> nova-compute --unset and verify VM scheduling works again.
1) 从告警标签取 hypervisor_hostname，执行 opensta: 1) Take hypervisor_hostname from the alert labels and run openstack hypervisor show <host> to compare memory_mb_used with memory_mb; 2) Log in to the node and compare with free -g; high allocation but low real usage means VM flavors are oversized and the business can be pushed to right-size them; 3) To free capacity, migrate some instances to idle nodes with openstack server migrate; 4) If the cluster as a whole is tight, add compute nodes and double-check that ram_allocation_ratio has not been set above 1 by mistake.

1) Take hypervisor_hostname from the alert labels and run openstack hypervisor show <host> to confirm vcpus_used and vcpus; 2) Read it together with cpu_allocation_ratio to see whether overcommit headroom remains; at the default 16:1 ratio the vcpus value is already the post-overcommit figure; 3) If idle VMs sit on this node, clean them up or migrate them with openstack server migrate; 4) If the whole cluster is short on headroom, add compute nodes, and first confirm the scheduler filters are not concentrating load on a few nodes.
1) 从告警标签取 hypervisor_hostname，登录节点执行 df: 1) Take hypervisor_hostname from the alert labels, log in to the node, and run df -h plus du -sh /var/lib/nova/instances/* | sort -rh | head to find the biggest consumers; 2) Clean up leftover directories from deleted instances and old base image caches (they accumulate indefinitely when nova's image cache manager is disabled); 3) To free capacity, migrate instances to other nodes or switch root disks to Cinder volume boot; 4) Longer term give /var/lib/nova/instances its own volume with a capacity alert.
Hypervisor 本地磁盘分配率过高: Hypervisor local disk allocation too high
有 Neutron Agent 处于非存活状态，该节点上的虚拟机网络将无法下发新: A Neutron agent is not alive. New network configuration cannot be applied to virtual machines on that node, so floating IP and security group changes will not take effect.
有 Nova 服务被标记为 forced_down，通常是运维手工下线或 HA: A Nova service is marked forced_down, normally because an operator took it offline or an HA component decided the compute node is unreachable. VMs on that node may already have been evacuated or are about to be.
该 Hypervisor 的 vCPU 分配率已超过 90%，新虚拟机无法调度到: This hypervisor's vCPU allocation exceeds 90%. New VMs cannot be scheduled onto this machine and the cluster's overall scheduling headroom is shrinking.
该 Hypervisor 的内存分配率已超过 90%，新虚拟机无法调度到这台机器: This hypervisor's memory allocation exceeds 90%. New VMs cannot be scheduled onto it, and since memory is usually not overcommitted, once it is full the node cannot take any new instance at all.
该 Hypervisor 的本地磁盘分配率已超过 90%，新虚拟机无法在此创建系: This hypervisor's local disk allocation exceeds 90%. New VMs cannot create root disks here, and growth of existing instance disks could fill the host and take the whole node down.
